propositions: The test monkeypatch closure observed_upsert has a narrower signature than the real CriterionBank.upsert, causing TypeError when production passes evidence_sufficient=False or seeded=True kwargs.

The bedrock LLM arm triggers the bounded-fallback path which calls upsert(..., evidence_sufficient=False), while anthropic/openai arms gather sufficient evidence and never enter fallback, explaining why the TypeError only manifests on bedrock.
The observed_upsert stub must forward all keyword arguments via **kwargs (preserving evidence_sufficient, seeded, and future params) to the real upsert to maintain signature parity with production.
A shared test helper make_observed_upsert in tests/_bank_observer.py should extract the bank-observation wrapper and be reused across live eval and unit regression tests without live dependencies.
The unit regression test must drive record_insufficient and seeded upsert paths through the wrapper to prove the TypeError is eliminated and kwargs are forwarded.
